neighbours.label: a physics word naming a rotational or wave property (spin, moment of inertia, frequency, eigenvalue)
fire: In quantum mechanics, the electron's spin can only take two values.
Pulling in her arms reduces the skater's moment of inertia, so she rotates faster.
A violin string vibrating faster produces a sound of higher frequency.
The stability of the system depends on the eigenvalues of the matrix.
Protons and neutrons also carry an intrinsic angular momentum called spin.
The resonant frequency of the circuit depends on its capacitance.
A heavier flywheel has a larger moment of inertia and resists changes.
Each energy level corresponds to an eigenvalue of the Hamiltonian.
quiet: In quantum mechanics, the electron's charge is exactly the same as the proton's.
Pulling in her arms, the skater smiled at the cheering crowd.
A violin string made of gut produces a warm and gentle sound.
The stability of the bridge depends on the quality of the steel.
Protons and neutrons are found together in the nucleus of the atom.
The power supply of the circuit sits on the left side of the board.
A heavier flywheel is harder to carry up the narrow stairs.
Each energy company sends a bill to its customers every month.
